title: 336 HZ × NUNCA SE BORRA (Liquid DnB Edit) [174]
style: liquid drum and bass, 174 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), bilingual chop weave English + Spanish + te reo Maori, rolling Amen-style breaks, deep Reese sub bass with smooth slides, lush atmospheric pads, jazzy Rhodes piano, soft female-pitched chops at +6 and grounded male chops at -3, 336 Hz drone embedded under sub, emotional uplifting late-night vibe, sidechain ducking pads to kick, club mainfloor 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(336 Hz drone, soft pad swell, Rhodes chord)
(THREE... THREE... SIX...)
(nun... ca... se... borra...)
(kao... re... e... mukua...)

[Build]
(break enters half-time, sub slides up)
336! 336! NUN — CA — SE — BORRA!
NEVER — ERASE!
KAO — RE — E — MUKUA!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(snare roll, riser sweep)

[Drop 1]
(rolling Amen break, Reese sub locks in)
NUN — CA!
SE — BORRA!
NE — VER!
E — RASE!
(chop stack +7) si-si-no-no / ae-ae-no-no / yes-yes-no-no
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(break drops to half, Rhodes solo)
(nada?) (nothing?) (kore?)
(siempre!) (always!) (mau tonu!)
(no se borra!) (never erase!) (kaore e mukua!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE FILE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to 336 Hz drone + Rhodes, no drums)
(whispered) nunca... se... borra...
(soft) never... erase...
(soft) kaore... e... mukua...
(piano lifts)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds, sub re-enters)

[Drop 2]
(double-time break, full Reese stack)
NUN — CA — SE — BORRA! (siempre siempre!)
NE — VER — E — RASE! (always always!)
KAO — RE — E — MUKUA! (mau tonu!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(break fades, 336 Hz drone holds)
(nunca... se... borra...)
(never... erase...)
(kaore... e... mukua...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(drone holds then fades)
